newsitem.title: ITALY: TENNIS-BERASATEGUI MEETS FRENCH OPEN'S KUERTEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BERASATEGUI MEETS FRENCH OPEN'S KUERTEN.

text.p: Top seed Alberto Berasategui reached the quarter finals of the $328,000 Bologna international men's clay-court tennis tournament on Thursday, where he meets French Open champion Gustavo Kuerten.
Berasategui, ranked 14 in the world, beat fellow Spaniard Albert Portas in two sets, pushing his way into the quarter finals with 6-2 6-3.
Kuerten, who is ranked 15 in the world after being catapulted up from 66 by his French victory, removed another Spaniard, qualifier Jacobo Diaz, from the competition, beating him 6-4 6-2.
The 20-year old Brazilian, who is seeded eighth here, also clocked up his 14th consecutive victory.
Earlier Italian Andrea Gaudenzi battled for two hours and 20 minutes for his place in the quarter finals.
Argentinian Franco Squillari conceded the match only on the 16th point of a tie-break in the third set after taking the first set 6-4 but losing the second 4-6.
In another Spain-Brazil duel, second seeded Felix Mantilla, ranked 16, was driven to three sets by Fernando Meligeni, ranked 75, before closing the match 6-7 7-5 6-2.
Mantilla now faces Ecuador's Nicolas Lapentti while Gaudenzi takes on six seed Karim Alami of Morocco. Fellow Moroccan Hicham Arazi, seeded five, will play Italian Marzio Martelli.
